sources.title: Turkey and Greece: tug-of-war over marine parks? - eurotopics.net
sources.snippet: 20 August 2026 Turkey and Greece: tug-of-war over marine parks? A new bone of contention has arisen between neighbouring Greece and Turkey. After Greece designated two marine protected areas in the Ionian and Aegean Seas in July 2025, Turkey has now followed suit by establishing two marine protected areas of its own.
